name: Humility (Tawadu)

definition_by_age.4: Not bragging about good things you did.
definition_by_age.6: Tawadu means staying humble and kind, even when you do something great.
definition_by_age.8: Tawadu is recognizing that all our gifts come from Allah, so we stay humble instead of boastful.

learning_objective: Children can describe being humble after doing well at something.

recommended_default.note: Reassigned 2026-08-05 during pattern-diversity fix (was pattern_010). Temptation to brag->Inner Conflict->Choice fits cf_031 (bragging after winning) directly.

qv_014.reasoning: Directly describes humble walking and peaceful response to rudeness — the concept's core definition.

alternative_patterns.reasoning: A sibling praised for the same quiet deed fits comparison->gratitude-shift directly.
